olivia: quick update — I ran an end-to-end on the paged-KV path with the new aging-based scheduler + kernel-fallback rules this morning. baseline: FlashAttn-v1 fused kernel, no paging. experiment: paged KV, block-table with soft-evict thresholds, kernel fallback to small-batch kernel under backpressure.

sam: nice. numbers?

olivia: 1k seq, batch=32, beam=1. p50 latency: baseline 92ms -> experiment 107ms. p95: baseline 210ms -> experiment 270ms. throughput dropped ~12% steady-state but tail increased with contention.

rahul: can you paste the perf counters? curious about memcpy + page fault spikes.

olivia: pasted run log:
```
RUN: ./bench --model t5-XXL --mode paged --batch 32 --seq 1024
KV_PAGER: soft_evict_threshold=0.6 hard=0.85
SCHED: aging_window_ms=150 memory_pressure_probe=50
KERNEL: primary=flashattn-v2 fallback=flashattn-smallbatch
RESULT: p50=107ms p95=270ms throughput=88 tok/s per-GPU
PAGE_FAULTS: 42 spikes at 11:23:41-11:23:43
MEMCPY_BYTES: 1.2GB/sec
```

maria: the page faults are the red flag. looks like our slab allocator is doing extra migrations when block-table compacts. could be the block-table compaction policy is too eager under the aging scheduler.

sam: agree. the aging scheduler moves hot entries to head and batches evicts lazily. if compaction runs while the kernel holds the KV pointers, we might be getting stalls. do we have stack traces for those spikes?

rahul: attached perf top diff from the spike window:
```
+ spin_on_slab_lock 35.4%
+ page_copy_kernel 22.1%
+ nv_shmem_memcpy 12.0%
+ flashattn_forward 9.3%
```

olivia: so lock contention + memcpy. I suspect the allocator's defrag path grabs the slab_lock and migrates pages to coalesce free ranges — that causes NV memcpy and blocks the kernel which then triggers fallback to the small-batch kernel (higher per-token cost).

zach: can we tweak compaction hysteresis? e.g., only run defrag if free_frac < 0.2 and no inflight kernels > 0.1s?

maria: yeah, propose: increase soft_evict_threshold to 0.75, only compact when free_frac < 0.15, and add compaction_backoff_ms = 500. Also add a quick check: if any kernel is in critical_section, postpone compaction.

sam: also evaluate kernel selection policy change: prefer small-batch kernel only when observed batch_latency > SLO or GPU_util < 40%. right now fallback kicks purely on page-fault/backpressure signals which are noisy.

olivia: good. I can run a microbench with these params. also want to try flashattn-v2 with a prefetcher disabled — suspect prefetcher is thrashing paged KV.

rahul: sanity microbench command I used:
```
./bench --model t5-XXL --mode paged --batch 32 --seq 1024 --kv-pager.soft=0.75 --kv-pager.compact-threshold=0.15 --kv-pager.compact-backoff=500 --kernel.prefetch=0
```

ci-bot: build #4271 succeeded (bench harness updated with pager telemetry). link: https://ci.redwood.internal/4271 :white_check_mark:

olivia: I pushed a branch with the hysteresis + kernel policy tweaks, PR: https://git.redwood/infra/kv-pager/pulls/89 — includes extra telemetry: slab_lock_hold_ms, memcpy_bytes/s, kernel_fallback_count per minute.

sam: great. can you also add a failing unit test that reproduces the compaction race? a small repro harness that spawns fake kernel threads holding pointers while compaction tries to migrate pages.

maria: I can write that test. will add to pager_unit_tests. also let's add a nightly e2e with large-seq workloads to the regression dashboard.

zach: long-term idea: make block-table compaction incremental and NUMA-aware (migrate only cold regions during low-util windows). but that's a follow-up.

olivia: short-term plan: run 3x microbench sweeps (baseline, hysteresis, hysteresis+prefetch off). collecting p50/p95, kernel_fallback_count, slab_lock_hold_ms. I'll post results here tomorrow.

rahul: thanks — if p95 improves we can promote the change to staging. priority flag: regression-hotfix.

olivia: ack. tagging @maria @sam for reviews on the PR and test.

sam: thx — also can we add a tiny dashboard panel showing memcpy_bytes/s next to p95? that'll make regression detection easier.

maria: added to infra/telemetry/dashboards/kv_pager.json (WIP).

olivia: ok closing loop for now. will post numbers in this thread. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
